def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r,c)]
            seen.add((r,c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y,x = q.pop()
                cells.append((y,x))
                for dy in (-1,0,1):
                    for dx in (-1,0,1):
                        yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]!=0 and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append(cells)
    if len(comps) < 2:
        return [[0]]
    comps.sort(key=len, reverse=True)
    masks=[]
    for cells in comps[:2]:
        r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)
        c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
        masks.append([[int((r,c) in set(cells)) for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)])
    H=max(map(len,masks)); W=max(map(len,masks[0]),map(len,masks[1]))
    padded=[]
    for a in masks:
        ah,aw=len(a),len(a[0])
        top=(H-ah)//2; left=(W-aw)//2
        p=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
        for y in range(ah):
            for x in range(aw): p[top+y][left+x]=a[y][x]
        padded.append(p)
    diff=[[8 if padded[0][y][x]!=padded[1][y][x] else 0 for x in range(W)] for y in range(H)]
    rr=[y for y in range(H) if any(diff[y])]
    cc=[x for x in range(W) if any(diff[y][x] for y in range(H))]
    if not rr or not cc: return [[0]]
    return [[diff[y][x] for x in cc] for y in rr]
"
